tax.text: Sell opposes using ability to pay as a reason to raise taxes and says lower taxes create jobs and economic opportunities.
tax.quote: People who make or generate more income will pay more taxes, but using "who can afford" as a justification for raising taxes is not good. With lower taxes they can also create more jobs and economic opportunities for working families.

trade.text: Sell defended Trump's confrontational trade strategy, saying it produced positive results against foreign competitors.
trade.quote: And so he has used the words, you know, we are going to have these trade wars with foreign nations, China especially. And you know, seven years ago, that had a positive impact by the latter part of the Trump Administration, the first time around, the first Trump Administration.

debt.text: Sell calls for spending controls, a balanced-budget requirement and continued government-efficiency efforts.
debt.quote: Control spending with stronger budget rules requiring a balanced budget. Congress must conduct strenuous oversight to ensure funds are used efficiently. The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) should be continued working in concert with Congress.

immigration.text: Sell supports border enforcement and deportations while also calling for legal immigration to become more transparent and accessible.
immigration.quote: I'm also a supporter of good immigration reform. Congress needs to step up and enact better laws to make legal immigration more transparent, more accountable, more accessible to those who want to come to our nation and live the American dream, but supporting our laws and enforcing our laws and supporting the law enforcement who do.

guns.text: Sell says law-abiding citizens should face no restrictions on gun ownership under the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: Law-abiding citizens should have no restrictions per the 2nd Amendment of the U.S. Constitution.

abortion.text: Sell says elective abortion should not be permitted and that unborn life should be protected.
abortion.quote: Elective abortion should not be allowed. Innocent life should be protected.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Sell supports excluding biological males from women's sports and sex-specific women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: Sell selected the option making government-funded insurance available to everyone alongside private coverage, while emphasizing personal responsibility and provider autonomy.
health.quote: B - We need a comprehensive overhaul which focuses on personal responsibility among the citizens and empowers doctors and hospitals in urban and rural settings to provide the highest quality services.

energy.text: Sell supports continuing policies that expand domestic energy production and benefit West Texas producers.
energy.quote: President Trump has once again unleashed U.S. energy production, West Texas has led the way and we must continue policies that build on this success.

voting.text: Sell supports requiring photo identification to vote, saying it is not a significant barrier.
voting.quote: Voting is a privilege, and a photo identification does not strike me as a significant barrier.

tax.text: Rable supported raising taxes on billionaires and large corporations and using federal public investment to provide jobs and services.
tax.quote: Yes. I believe there is no moral way to be a billionaire. You do not make billions without destroying workers and their families.

wages.text: Rable endorsed a federal minimum wage of $17 per hour indexed to inflation.
wages.quote: 100%. The federal minimum wage has left the American Working Class in poverty. We must make sure workers are paid a fair wage and that they can feed and clothe their families.

trade.text: Rable opposed Trump's trade war and called for Congress to limit presidential power to impose excess tariffs.
trade.quote: Americans should not bear the brunt of Trump's trade war with our longtime allies. Congress must act to rein in Presidential powers and limit the White House's ability to force Americans to pay for the excess tariffs.

debt.text: Rable pledged to protect Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, and veterans' benefits rather than cut access.
debt.quote: Medicaid, Medicare, Social Security, and Veterans Affairs are essential to supporting working families and veterans who rely on these programs to live long, happy, economically free lives. In Congress, I will fight to ensure these programs are delivered to everyone who has paid into them.

immigration.text: Rable called for streamlining legal immigration so more immigrants can enter the country lawfully.
immigration.quote: The legal immigration process in the U.S. is far too complex, and this complexity encourages illegal immigration. We must streamline the immigration process to enable immigrants to enter the United States legally.

health.text: Rable proposed extending Medicare coverage to every child under age 18.
health.quote: It is the duty of a moral and righteous society to ensure that children grow up healthy, with basic needs met. To do this, I will also fight for Medicare for all children under 18.
